claude-code.reason: Plugin hooks run automatic maintenance and transcript capture at session boundaries.
claude-code.policy_hook_reason: hooks/hooks.json registers a blocking PreToolUse policy hook for every tool.

cursor.reason: Cursor hooks run the shared lifecycle at session start and stop.
cursor.policy_hook_reason: hooks/hooks-cursor.json registers a preToolUse policy hook for every tool.

vscode.reason: The extension performs automatic maintenance, but generic VS Code exposes no agent transcript lifecycle.
vscode.policy_hook_reason: VS Code exposes no pre-tool hook for another extension's agent tools.

codex.reason: Trusted Codex plugin or repository hooks run the shared lifecycle at SessionStart and Stop.
codex.policy_hook_reason: The Codex plugin registers a PreToolUse policy hook once its hooks are trusted; repository-only setup (.codex/hooks.json) installs lifecycle hooks only.

opencode.reason: The OpenCode plugin runs shared lifecycle maintenance on normal chat turns.
opencode.policy_hook_reason: The OpenCode plugin injects policy text but registers no tool.execute.before handler yet.

antigravity.reason: Workspace hooks run maintenance on PreInvocation and capture on Stop.
antigravity.policy_hook_reason: No pre-tool policy hook is registered for Antigravity yet.

windsurf.reason: Cascade hooks run maintenance and transcript capture when Restricted Mode is disabled.
windsurf.policy_hook_reason: No pre_run_command or pre_write_code policy hook is registered for Windsurf yet.

kiro.reason: Kiro v1 SessionStart and Stop hooks run the shared lifecycle.
kiro.policy_hook_reason: No preToolUse policy hook is registered for Kiro yet.

copilot.reason: Copilot CLI and coding-agent hooks are covered; IDE chat transcript lifecycle is not exposed consistently.
copilot.policy_hook_reason: No preToolUse policy hook is registered for Copilot yet.
